People: Coventry Patmore (author, Wikidata Q716197), died 1896; Henry Morley (editor, Wikidata Q2401379), died 1894. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Patmore, Coventry, 1823-1896; Morley, Henry, 1822-1894 [Editor]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: The victories of love, and other poems, Cassell, 1888, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/victoriesofloveo00patm. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 82%, 84%, 83% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Henry Morley, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
